meta.title: Knowledge graph
meta.description: Topic connections across mathematics, physics, quantum and digital logic.
notes: One node represents one existing topic page. Categories use the page's subject folder; three catalogued logic calculators belong to digital logic.
Prerequisite edges reuse the existing subject maps and their lesson mappings without a new content review.
The existing quantum map includes catalogue-order study progression and a suggested learning backbone.
Content links come from lesson bodies; navigation and generated progression cards are excluded.
Relationship direction runs from background to the dependent lesson for prerequisites, and from linking lesson to linked lesson for content links.
Pages with no recorded connections remain visible. No similarity or AI-inferred relationships are added.

edgeTypes.label: Prerequisite
edgeTypes.description: Source supports target in an existing prerequisite map. These are study guides, not exam requirements.

edgeTypes.label: Recommended background
edgeTypes.description: Source is recommended background for target in an existing prerequisite map.

edgeTypes.label: Content link
edgeTypes.description: Source lesson links to target within its teaching content. A link does not imply a prerequisite.
